634290.title: Malvina
634290.overview: Talented as a child but completely lost in her thirties, Vasya suddenly realizes she's heading for rock bottom and has no strength to escape. Malvina, an imaginary friend from childhood, comes to his aid, a freakish woman with purple hair and a quirky sense of humor. Malvina pushes Vasya to find her childhood love, Stasik. Vasya will go through a long journey and understand what went wrong in her life, but most importantly, she will learn why Malvina appeared.

889330.title: Humboldt USA
889330.overview: Countless places across the United States still bear the name of Alexander von Humboldt — queer traveler, visionary naturalist, now largely forgotten. The longing filmmaker uses three of them as unlikely common ground, weaving Humboldt's own words through present-day lives: urban activists greening neglected neighborhoods, scientists scanning redwood forests, hunters returning bighorn sheep to protected land. Across generations and landscapes, HUMBOLDT USA asks what remains of a vision of "interconnectedness."

1000882.title: The Sunrise File
1000882.overview: The Sunrise File is a geopolitical thriller in which a Mossad agent seeks to determine the fate of former Nazi executioners.  The film takes us on a breathtaking tale of espionage from the end of the Second World War to the trial of Klaus Barbie, between Paris, Berlin, La Paz and Tel Aviv.

1062066.title: Brave Heart Yakari
1062066.overview: While his friend Buffalo-Seed is in a deep coma and Rainbow reveals her shaman skills by keeping him alive, Yakari gallops off with Little-Thunder in search of the only living being capable of bringing him back to life: Buffalo-Seed's totem, the imposing, fantastic and dangerous Thathanka!

1081010.title: Prahaar
1081010.overview: Ujjwal Nikam is an Indian special public prosecutor who has worked on prominent murder and terrorism cases such as the 1993 Bombay bombings, the Gulshan Kumar murder case, the Pramod Mahajan murder case, and the 2008 Mumbai attacks.

1088434.title: Hellfire
1088434.overview: A drifter with a mysterious past arrives in a small town and finds the residents in the grip of a ruthless crime boss and realizes he has to help them.

1126706.title: Ducks
1126706.overview: A young Frenchman of Cambodian origins goes to his country in search of himself.

1127282.title: Prima Facie
1127282.overview: Tessa is a brilliant British defence barrister dominating London’s ruthless courtrooms. Fierce, witty, and self-made, she defends men accused of sexual assault — until she is assaulted herself by a colleague from a powerful legal dynasty.  Suddenly, the system she trusted turns against her. As she faces the same tactics she once used in court, Tessa’s faith in justice unravels. Once in control, now exposed and disbelieved, she must fight to reclaim her voice and sense of self.

1158642.title: Jean-Michel
1158642.overview: Follows Basquiat’s early life as the child of middle-class Haitian and Puerto Rican parents in Brooklyn, through his adventures in the punk subculture and up to his breakout as a major American artist. All the while, special attention is paid to Basquiat’s mental and emotional state, with interviews from former friends and colleagues to supplement his sisters’ impressions.

1249202.title: Trust Me, I'm a Doctor
1249202.overview: The life of Dr. Sandeep Kapoor was turned upside down when he's implicated in the wrongful death trial of one-time Playboy centerfold Anna Nicole Smith.

1249458.title: User Not Found
1249458.overview: Two men and women with unknown identities, a live online trial in a confined space, and an extreme escape between death and truth

1260210.title: Aadu 3
1260210.overview: Shaji Pappan and Co. opens a Pandora's box of reincarnations and multiple timelines  leading to comic chaos of epic proportions.
1260210.trailerName: Aadu 3 Official Trailer | Jayasurya | Midhun Manuel Thomas |Vijay Babu & Venu Kunnappilly| Vinayakan

1290418.title: The Cycle
1290418.overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.
1290418.trailerName: THE CYCLE | Deborah Ann Woll, Jeffrey Donovan | Teaser Trailer | Shudder

1297842.title: GOAT
1297842.overview: A small goat with big dreams gets a once-in-a-lifetime shot to join the pros and play roarball, a high-intensity, co-ed, full-contact sport dominated by the fastest, fiercest animals in the world.

1335666.title: Glenrothan
1335666.overview: After 35 years in Chicago, Donal reluctantly returns to the Scottish Highlands to reconcile with his estranged older brother Sandy. Sandy needs Donal to take over the family's whisky distillery or he'll be forced to sell and give up on the family's legacy. But their reunion forces the brothers to confront the past and the real reason Donal left Glenrothan.

1354930.title: Family Squad
1354930.overview: A case of mistaken identity lands solitary gas attendant Serhii in heaven. To earn his way back, he's tasked with locating an individual whose life he can positively impact, spurring his pursuit to reconnect with the father he never met.

1364978.title: The Witch Pricker And The Hare
1364978.overview: During Scotland’s witch trials in the 17th century, an infamous witch pricker struggles to execute a particularly clever witch when their true identity is at risk of being exposed.

1383154.title: The Eyes
1383154.overview: Seo-jin, a renowned photographer, is shattered by the sudden and mysterious death of her twin sister and sets out to uncover the truth. As her investigation deepens, an unseen presence begins to close in, twisting reality and driving her into a spiral of paranoia as her vision fades away. Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.
1383154.trailerName: THE EYES (OFFICIAL TRAILER) IN CINEMAS 23 JULY

1394098.title: Sister
1394098.overview: Desperate to raise money for her younger sister's surgery, Hae-ran teams up with Tae-soo to kidnap her half-sister So-jin. So-jin wakes up confined in an unfamiliar place. Hae-ran and Tae-soo demand a hefty ransom, expecting her wealthy father to cough up the money. Upon discovering that one of her captors is her half-sister, So-jin enters a precarious alliance that blurs the lines between victim and perpetrator as she plots a counterattack against the ruthless Tae-soo.

1401586.title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
1401586.overview: Sonic the Hedgehog, joined by a new hero named Amy, faces a new technological nemesis known as Metal Sonic.

1432306.title: Sleepwalker
1432306.overview: A grieving mother is haunted by the tragic loss of her daughter in a car accident that left her abusive husband in a coma. As she battles a surreal descent into darkness, her sleepwalking episodes intensify. Plagued by haunting visions of her husband inside their home, she grapples with the blurred lines between reality and nightmare.

1433842.title: Relationship Goals
1433842.overview: When TV producer Leah Caldwell aims to become the first woman running New York's top morning show, her ex competes for the same role. Leah stays focused on her career, until chemistry with her ex challenges her priorities.

1440050.title: The Breadwinner
1440050.overview: After his wife Katie lands a once-in-a-lifetime deal on Shark Tank that takes her on a prolonged business trip - lifelong breadwinner Nate Wilcox now has to fend for his family as a first-time stay-at-home dad.

1444466.title: Awarapan 2
1444466.overview: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

1446898.title: Mu-Ki-Ra
1446898.overview: When her brother is kidnapped by Mu-Ki-Ra, Cleo ventures into a monster-plagued jungle with unlikely allies.

1449970.title: Hold to Death: Hand in Hand
1449970.overview: The teacher is invited by someone she likes to join a class reunion. They play a game to invite ghosts to make friends, unaware that curses are placed upon them. There is a reason for the malevolence.

1452018.title: Women as Lovers
1452018.overview: Although hostess Brigitte and life-loving schoolgirl Paula only meet in person once, their fates and lives are closely intertwined.

1454834.title: Last Chance Motel
1454834.overview: A newlywed couple's dream wedding spirals into a bloody nightmare when they uncover that their secluded venue- a desolate motel deep in the Nevada desert- is run by a relentless bloodthirsty family with dark secrets, revealing that one bride's future may not be all that it was promised to be.
1454834.trailerName: Last Chance Motel | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1461490.title: Hershey
1461490.overview: Based on the life of Milton Hershey, founder of the iconic Hershey chocolate company.  Milton's grit and determination to conquer the world of candy-making propel him from bankruptcy to monumental success, and the love of his life, Kitty, helps him build a legacy sweeter than any candy bar. But when Kitty falls ill, Milton’s wild optimism teeters on the edge of destruction, and she sparks an even bolder dream: to leave their fortune in the hands of America’s orphans.

1470130.title: The Mortuary Assistant
1470130.overview: Rebecca Owens, a recent mortuary science graduate takes a night shift job at River Fields Mortuary. Initially, the job seems straightforward — embalming bodies, completing paperwork, and keeping things tidy. But once Rebecca starts working the night shift, things take a dark turn.

1474226.title: Evil Dress
1474226.overview: After a difficult divorce, Alicia moves into an old house with her daughter Carla, unaware that it hides a past of recurrent tragedy. As Carla senses perturbing presences, Alicia begins to doubt her own sanity. A blue dress connects Carla to the ghost of a girl from the past, triggering terrifying events. Mother and daughter will try to escape the house, but the house won’t let them get away so easily.

1476466.title: Trial of Hein
1476466.overview: After 14 years away, Hein returns to his home village on a remote island, only to discover that the close-knit community no longer recognises him. Suspecting him to be an impostor, they demand a trial to determine his true identity.

1477170.title: LOL 2.0: Anne’s Golden Hour
1477170.overview: At 55, Anne is finally enjoying her freedom after her children leave home. But everything changes when her 23-year-old daughter, Louise, moves back in with her after a professional and romantic failure. And to make matters worse, her son, Théo, announces that she's going to be a grandmother! Anne realizes that life never goes as planned and that, at any age, we are still learning to grow up.

1493426.title: Chasing Millions
1493426.overview: The Northern Bank chain was owned by the National Australia Bank. Diana, a young Australian police detective in Belfast at the same time, seizes the opportunity to investigate the biggest crime of her career and prove herself to her misogynistic bosses back home who have passed her over for promotion. Diana is teamed with Crawford, a gruff, veteran Northern Irish police detective who does not want her help. As the case takes one more bizarre turn after another, the duo learn to grudgingly respect each other. As they almost give up hope of catching the criminals, Diana comes up with an ingenious plan which will make the stolen millions worthless.
1493426.trailerName: Chasing Millions - Official Trailer - In Cinemas October 9th

1513010.title: Dance of the Living
1513010.overview: On the arid island of Fuerteventura, Miguel and his daughter Mariana struggle to move forward after his wife’s death, a loss that has set them adrift. Traditional wrestling is all they know, their way of making a place in the world. But Miguel’s body is failing him, and Mariana’s anger is pushing her to break the rules. As the championship final approaches, father and daughter find themselves on uncertain ground, searching for a way back to each other before it’s too late.
1513010.trailerName: DANCE OF THE LIVING - International Trailer

1514034.title: The Bell: Panggilan Untuk Mati
1514034.overview: When a stolen bell unleashes the vengeful ghost of Panebok in Belitong, a shaman’s last descendant must recover the artifact and master forbidden rituals to stop its bloody rampage—before nine lives are claimed, including his own.

1526194.title: Sylvia
1526194.overview: Sylvia is waiting for her life to begin, withering under the weight of her hypochondriac mother until a stranger comes into her world and changes everything.

1533042.title: Poultrygeist II: Dawn of the Chicken Dead
1533042.overview: A global poultry pandemic sets the stage for a wealthy tech tycoon to attempt to relaunch a failed fast-food empire using lab-grown synthetic chicken. Things go horribly wrong when these artificial food supplies unleash a wave of mutant chicken zombies.
1533042.trailerName: Poultrygeist 2: Dawn of the Chicken Dead (2026) -   Official Teaser Trailer

1545266.title: GOKDU;spreads its wings
1545266.overview: Jang Min-gi has spent his life hiding a secret: he can see the dead. When his estranged father — the last in a line of Kokdu, ritual guardians who escort souls to the afterlife — dies under mysterious circumstances, Min-gi inherits both a worn puppet kit and a burden he never wanted. Drawn into a thirty-year-old betrayal surrounding a burned funeral bier, he must confront an imprisoned soul demanding vengeance.

1552242.title: Nobody's Violence
1552242.overview: Mira is a solitary woman of few words. She travels the roads meeting desperate people with whom she seems to have forged strange death pacts. With no apparent destination, she meets Madeleine and Ludo, two free-spirited hedonists living deep in the forest. Taking a break from her missions and unsettled by a sudden encounter with an excessive and intriguing young man, she uses this stopover to question her wandering life and reassess her dark agreements.

1573810.title: Dream Team
1573810.overview: Marek is a failed basketball coach whose disabled son dreams of participating in the Paralympics in Rio. Unable to field a team of disabled athletes, Marek resorts to fraud and, under the influence of a slightly crazy neighbor, hires able-bodied basketball players to fake their disabilities. Together with his unsuspecting wife, he and his "dream team" set off for Rio, and it is only under the hot Brazilian sun that Marek realizes how karma is catching up with him and that even the best sporting performance may not be enough to escape it. The film Dream Team is not only full of crazy comic situations, but also tells the story of personal honor and the power of parental love.

1577970.title: Arrested Memory
1577970.overview: Lee is a superstar police detective in Taipei. After losing his team during a crime investigation, he is haunted by guilt and transferred to a rural police station. Traumatized by the incident, Lee develops amnesia—but is determined to keep it a secret. Soon, he is assigned a new case: the kidnapping of the son of an influential Japanese businessman. As his memory continues to fade, Lee can only rely on his instincts—which, against all odds, lead him to the criminals.

1579442.title: Khan Tumhara
1579442.overview: A genre blend of action sequences with romance and drama, centering on the character Yusuf Khan, described as navigating power, love and vengeance.
1579442.trailerName: Khan Tumhara | Official Teaser | Bilal Ashraf & Maya Ali | Eid ul-Adha 2026 | HUM Films

1582770.title: Dhurandhar: The Revenge
1582770.overview: As rival gangs, corrupt officials and a ruthless Major Iqbal close in, Hamza's mission for his country spirals into a bloody personal war where the line between patriot and monster disappears in the streets of Lyari.

1589426.title: Thank You Charlotte
1589426.overview: Film focuses on the relationship between a child from Turkiye, so less than 10-years-old, and a French mother which she adopted him. It’s about the relationship of different worlds.

1599090.title: Skyscraper Live
1599090.overview: No ropes. No fear. Free solo legend Alex Honnold risks it all in a high-stakes, live ascent of one of the world's tallest skyscrapers in Taipei, Taiwan.

1602930.title: Tales of a Wandering City Girl
1602930.overview: Eloíse is an immortal woman who wanders the streets of São Paulo registering everyday life when she finds Lola, a 26 year old photographer who's confused about her future. Together they'll find in each other a way to face the burdens of life.

1610418.title: The House on Haunted Grounds
1610418.overview: What begins as a routine investigation into a house slated for demolition turns into a nightmare when the team faces an evil force, leaving behind only the recovered footage.

1610866.title: Is It Cake? Valentines
1610866.overview: Cupid's arrow has struck the Is It Cake kitchen for the first-ever Valentines special! Three baking couples of master cake artists compete. Together, they tackle ALL NEW games, craft swoonworthy cakes, and attempt to fool the judges and each other! AND for the first time in Is It Cake history, there are games just for the viewer! With hearts pounding and money on the line, these couples are in for the sweetest date night of their lives!

1612018.title: Jackass: Best and Last
1612018.overview: The fifth and final installment to Jackass franchise where the crew go on one last insane crusade.

1613874.title: Spring
1613874.overview: In a Russian-occupied town in southeastern Ukraine, where burying the dead has been forbidden, the church of a young priest, Andriy, has been turned into a morgue for executed Ukrainian civilians. As the occupation tightens its grip, Andriy quietly begins to resist, secretly returning the bodies to their families at great personal risk. Along the way, he forms an unexpected bond with Makarov, an 11-year-old boy who becomes the silent witness to his rebellion.

1620978.title: Hachazo
1620978.overview: A bachelor party becomes a mystery when the groom disappears without a trace.

1622194.title: Quién Llorará Por Mí
1622194.overview: The greatest fear a mother of a son with disabilities holds is the future: the uncertainty of what will happen to her son once she is gone.

1624498.title: The Colour of My Heart
1624498.overview: Zia Mohyeddin, Pakistan's most venerated actor, devotes his final years to resurrecting interest in Urdu poetry and passing it on to a new generation of South Asians.
1624498.trailerName: 'The Colour of My Heart' 'Rung Hai Dil Ka Mere' Official Trailer

1627058.title: Elza
1627058.overview: With her radical voice, visceral improvisation, and unmistakable rasp, Elza Soares created a language all her own and crossed generations, continually reinventing herself as one of Brazil’s greatest artists. In the documentary that bears her name, Elza narrates her own story, weaving together a diary of memories, desires, and reflections through music, in dialogue with historic Brazilian films. Through Elza and her nearly century-long life, the film offers an X-ray of a country in turmoil.

1627954.title: The Wicker Children
1627954.overview: Undercover cop investigates disappearance of mother tied to cult, unraveling dark pagan rituals involving her strange children at secluded country house.
1627954.trailerName: 'THE WICKER CHILDREN' Official Horror Trailer (2026) Pagan Cult Thriller

1628082.title: Gerta Schnirch
1628082.overview: Gerta grows up in 1930s Brno in a mixed Czech-German family, which brings her into conflict with her father as he embraces Nazi ideology. Despite this, they remain connected through their shared love of music. During the occupation, Gerta joins the student resistance with her beloved Karel, but the war takes everything from her and leaves her with a dark secret that shapes her future.  After the war, though innocent, Gerta is violently forced into the wild expulsion and must leave her hometown with her infant daughter. She survives the hardest years on a rural farm, reunites with Karel, and returns to Brno hoping for a normal life—yet the past continues to haunt her.  The two-part TV film Gerta Schnirch offers a personal view of 20th-century history through the fate of a woman caught between two worlds.

1628658.title: Straight Guy Watches Gay Porn for the First Time
1628658.overview: When Janek, a straight Polish guy watches gay porn for the first time, his world is turned upside down. Battling with unsettling new thoughts, he is put into a journey of self-discovery.

1632818.title: Dark Distortion
1632818.overview: A group of adult models turned thieves who face unintended consequences after stealing a camcorder that houses the spirit of a murdered child.
1632818.trailerName: Dark Distortion | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1635314.title: A Bit of Meaning
1635314.overview: Antoni lives by routine and isolation, hoping they will keep his depression and guilt at bay. His carefully controlled life is disrupted when he meets Olga, a volatile but determined warehouse worker whose reckless energy and dream of opening a bakery pull him into an unexpected relationship.

1635570.title: Beloved
1635570.overview: Asle and Gerd met in a small coastal village far west towards the sea. They have a son, and for a time their happiness is perfect. But Asle, the sailor, is restless and is drawn to the sea, while Gerd is left in the village, alone with the child. The distance between them folds, and the question is asked: How much distance can love tolerate?

1644210.title: Robotica
1644210.overview: Two security guards working the midnight shift in an adult toy company find themselves the target of a half-dismantled and severely malfunctioning female sex doll prototype named Robotica.

1646450.title: And Then Everything Turned Itself Inside Out
1646450.overview: In a world where birthmarks are investigated to reveal who people were and how they died in a past life, one man fears that the truth about his previous life could change everything.

1646706.title: Morpheus and Charon
1646706.overview: A throuple of queer elderly men deals with the proximity of death — Zito, who has been diagnosed with dementia, and his two lovers, Morpheus and Charon. As the illness progresses, the boundaries between dream and reality blur: Zito imagines his last days as if his whole life was a Brazilian samba musical extravaganza, while his partners in life take care of him until their last farewell.

1648434.title: The Final Hour
1648434.overview: A group of friends find themselves trapped in a deadly situation as a mysterious killer begins hunting them one by one during the final hour.

1650162.title: Sincerely, Victor
1650162.overview: A man, riddled with fear, enters the darkness of the forest. Followed by a shadowy figure, he must confront his mysterious past—or be consumed by the very thing that lured him there.

1653298.title: Prasert
1653298.overview: Prasert, the owner of a corrupt rental car business, is chased by top gunmen from all over the country after becoming involved in the murder of the Eastern governor.

1658226.title: Sana: Play with Me
1658226.overview: Right before summer vacation, a "forbidden game" is secretly played at a high school. After some students take part in it, their ordinary days begin to change, and before long, a "certain incident" occurs. Taking the situation seriously, the school brings in a counselor, Koharu, to provide mental care for the students who witnessed the incident. However, one of the students who played the "game" turns out to be Koharu's sister, Nanami. One by one, the students are drawn into bizarre phenomena.

1662770.title: Mother Promise
1662770.overview: A gambler loses everything in Bengaluru and flees from dons, smugglers, and misfits while his own mother joins the pursuit. A riotous comedy about chaos, family, and the one promise even the toughest men dare not break.

1668978.title: Where do Artists go when they Die?
1668978.overview: College sophomore Miles Stoops decides on a whim to make a movie with no clear direction, but is repeatedly distracted by JRPG monologues, a second animated feature, and premonitions of their own death.

1674034.title: Wellness Retreat
1674034.overview: A successful business woman seeks out a wellness retreat to improve her sleep. When she finds the location is actually a seedy motel, her exhaustion takes the lead and she chooses to stay the night, despite her better judgment.

1676466.title: Full Circle: The First All Black Everest Ascent
1676466.overview: An all-Black team sets out to summit Mount Everest not just to make history, but to redefine what it means to climb and who belongs in the mountains.

1678066.title: Night in the Valley of Witches
1678066.overview: This film is set in the Valley of the Witches area within Ghibli Park and is the first original animated short film created by Studio Ghibli specifically for the park.

1679282.title: Death, Taxes, And Fantasy Baseball
1679282.overview: After loosing their fantasy baseball league three people must attend a funeral for a person they don't know and act like they belong.

1679730.title: THE RIBBON HERO
1679730.overview: When the monstrous Nergal devastates her kingdom, Princess Sapphire reawakens as the Ribbon Hero and fights to save her new home from the same dark fate.

1679986.title: ee
1679986.overview: When a young girl attempts to shoplift an old blind box figure from a collectibles store, the shopkeeper’s seductive wife takes an interest in her.

1680882.title: The Founder5 II: Unfinished Business
1680882.overview: Grander, bolder and sharper, the Founder5 returns to the stage with other talented comedians for more standup, improv and sketch comedy.

1686578.title: Gio Love
1686578.overview: A boy in a world of pure fantasy ventures for his love that he covets, Gio. Yet, this boy isn't the only one.

1686834.title: A Castle of Our Own
1686834.overview: When an overworked architect takes an unexpected summer trip, a sandcastle contest and a contractor help her reconnect with her daughter, rediscover joy, and find love she never saw coming.

1688882.title: Kika Não Foi Convidada
1688882.overview: A young girl discovers she is not welcome at a birthday party. As they learn the value of true friendship, children offer a lesson in empathy and inclusion.

1689970.title: Mama'ku – Van Jakarta tot de Molukken
1689970.overview: Mama’ku: During a trip to Indonesia, dancer Cheroney Pelupessy and her taciturn mother find a way together to come to terms with the mother’s repressed past, marked by migration, domestic violence, and intergenerational trauma. The new documentary by Sven Peetoom (Tussen Wal en Schip – Geruisloos Indisch).

1692530.title: Behind Bars - Shot in the Spotlight

1698418.title: Adili Idola Celebrity Roast: Fedi Nuril
1698418.overview: Actor Fedi Nuril takes the hot seat as he faces hilarious jokes from a panel of six comedians and celebrities through the “Trilogy of Laughter”.

1699250.title: Final Transmissions
1699250.overview: Final Transmissions is an upcoming six-episode analog horror anthology series that features six short, found-footage films, set to be created using analog technology and VHS tapes to evoke a '90s television aesthetic.

1700210.title: Eclogues
1700210.overview: Landscapes are permeable, impermanent. They are hallucinations of literature, manifestations of human manipulation. Like the pixel, they are degraded, rearranged, forgotten. “Eclogues” is an expression of landscape in the purest principles of digital image-making: duration, practicality, limitation. Shot in 2020 in Strafford, Vermont.

1701554.title: Jhora Bokul
1701554.overview: Upcoming Eid UL Adha Natok of Bangladesh 2026
1701554.trailerName: Jhora Bokul | Yash Rohan | Sunerah | Rinku | Full Natok | New Bangla Natok 2026

1703154.title: Fire Tornado
1703154.overview: A dysfunctional rehab group is stranded at a rundown cabin as a roaring firenado melts everything in its path. With roads gone and heat rising, the misfits must combine their strange skills to fortify the house and survive the firestorm’s return.

1703346.title: Youthie
1703346.overview: On a northern English estate, a teenager quietly overwhelmed by responsibility at home begins to find hope through the support of a local youth worker.

1705202.title: FC Barcelona: Dream, Play, Win
1705202.overview: A documentary that chronicles the transformation of the FC Barcelona women's team, from anonymity to the best team in the world. It's not just a sports story, but a tale of overcoming challenges, identity, culture, and female empowerment. Through three acts, it constructs an emotional journey through its players and their quest for glory in the UWCL finals.
1705202.trailerName: FC Barcelona: Soñar, Jugar, y Ganar | Trailer

1706610.title: Lavender
1706610.overview: When lesbian writer Audrey runs into her ex-boyfriend, Julian, she must confront her bisexual panic or risk losing her sense of identity.

1707186.title: Watermelon in Wintertime
1707186.overview: Set in Oakland, Watermelon in Wintertime is a radical horror music video following a being who embodies society’s outcasts. Compelled to exist, in spite of systemic violence, physical and spiritual warfare and their mental health. And forced to eat surreal winter watermelons — a metaphor for the media-fed narratives of war and genocide — their journey becomes a visceral protest against oppression from America to Palestine to Sudan.

1711282.title: wyrdo
1711282.overview: A Christmas dinner party is interrupted by an uninvited guest.

1712306.title: Get to Work
1712306.overview: A man struggles in his bathroom through a severe panic attack as he desperately tries to work through it and get to work on time.

1713202.title: Francesca Hennessy vs. Aurora De Persio
1713202.overview: Hennessy will be aiming to defend her WBC Silver bantamweight title against Italian De Persio to set up a fight against undisputed bantamweight champion Cherneka Johnson later this year.  "This is another important test for me," said 21-year-old Hennessy. "I've always wanted to challenge myself against good opponents because that's what will prepare me for world title fights."

1714098.title: Lesbian Cleaning Service
1714098.overview: Between meticulous flower arrangements and sanitising sex toys, they must face the inevitable questions and washes of pain that come with falling in and out of love.

1714226.title: Sang Suraksha
1714226.overview: How difficult it is to find work in Indonesia, which means many people are forced to work to survive on minimal wages.

1714418.title: Fix
1714418.overview: When Victoria, a pharmaceutical executive, discovers her long-lost brother Damian is homeless and struggling with addiction, she takes a bold step-secretly administering an experimental drug to help him get back on his feet. All seems to be going well until the drug runs out.

1716018.title: Identity V STAGE Episode 6 [The Abyss of Art]
1716018.overview: A recurring four-against-one game of “tag” at the manor.  It was a stage with no final act, where neither survivors nor hunters could escape,  each carrying their past and their desires.  Edgar, a painter newly invited to the manor, finds himself in the midst of this life-or-death game, where he encounters raw inspiration that shakes him to his core.  Facing him is Galatea, a sculptor who ceaselessly seeks her “perfect self” and is obsessed with a maddening ideal.
